personal.name: Aryaman Pradhan
personal.title: AI Strategist
personal.headline: Give your team back the hours repetitive work is taking.
personal.subheadline: I build AI-integrated workflow systems that take over the work your business repeats every week, like research, replies, onboarding and publishing, so your people spend their time on decisions that actually need judgment.
personal.tagline: I give teams back the hours they lose to repetitive work — Python automation built against the tools you already use.
personal.bio: I work with marketing and creative agencies to turn their recurring operational work into software that runs itself. The builds are Python against real APIs (Notion, Gmail, Slack, Sheets) with language models handling the parts that need judgment, and human approval gates on anything that reaches a customer. No no-code platforms, no per-run billing, no vendor lock-in.

principles: Python against real APIs, not no-code glue. No Zapier, no per-run billing, no platform you don't control.
Every AI output is evaluated before it ships. Structured evals and scoring rubrics on every agent, not vibes.
Human gate on anything customer-facing. The model drafts, a person approves, nothing goes out without a sign-off.
Guardrails are built in, not bolted on. Input validation, output filtering, scope boundaries, and hallucination checks are part of the architecture.
Scoped to fail loud. A silent wrong answer costs more than an error your team can see and fix.
I'll tell you when automation is the wrong answer. If a spreadsheet or a hire solves it better, I'll say that before writing a line of code.

projects.name: Grounded Website Assistant for Hotels
projects.brief: One script tag on a hotel's site. Answers only from the owner's own documents, cites them, declines the rest.
projects.objective: A grounded assistant dropped onto the hotel and homestay websites I build. It answers a visitor's questions using only that property's own published documents, cites the source behind every claim, and declines rather than guesses. It deliberately does not transact: availability, bookings and payment stay with the booking engine.
outcomes: Every property-specific claim is checked against its sources by a second, blocking model pass. An answer that fails is never shown
Retrieved documents are screened for prompt injection, because owner-supplied is not the same as trusted
A public endpoint that costs money per call: origin allowlist, per-IP rate limit, and a daily spend cap per property
Every deflected question is logged, so the gaps in a property's content surface as a to-do list instead of staying hidden

projects.name: Football Content Research Pipeline

projects.objective: An automated research-to-script pipeline for a short-form football content creator. Takes a client-curated queue of football legends, researches the best chronologically-fitting stories for each with sourced references, and produces a complete script — with two human approval gates handled entirely inside Notion.

Every story candidate and every researched fact carries a mandatory source URL
AI drafts one complete script; the human decides how to split it into episodes
Eval harness gates the research and script agents before anything ships
